# Merchgraph

> A neutral, verified guide to anime and game merchandise from Japan and around the world: what exists, what it originally cost, and how fans actually get it. Organised by series. Kingdom Hearts is live; Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba) and One Piece are in preparation. For figures, apparel, accessories, books, music, games and collectibles from Japanese and Western releases, each catalog records official licensing status, the maker's original price by acquisition type, availability, and how each entry was checked.

## What this is
- A curated catalog, not a marketplace: no listings, no transactions, nothing is sold here.
- Each entry is checked by a person against a primary source (the maker's or official retailer's page, or reliable press such as Famitsu or 4Gamer), linked from the entry. Entries are marked verified or not; prices and availability that could only be checked indirectly are labeled as estimates.
- Official licensed merchandise is the core. A few fan-made brands are included on purpose so they can be told apart from official merch; they are clearly labeled "unofficial / fan-made".
- Prices are the maker's original prices (per draw for ichiban-kuji, per capsule for gachapon), not current resale prices. Items released outside Japan keep their original currency and are also shown converted to yen at a fixed rate.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the rights holders of any series listed (for Kingdom Hearts: Square Enix, Disney), or by any maker, shop or marketplace.

## Key pages
- [Merchgraph home](https://merchgraph.app/): choose a series. Shows which series are live and which are in preparation.

### Kingdom Hearts (live)
- [Browse the catalog](https://merchgraph.app/kingdomhearts/): search by character, budget and category. Open an item with `https://merchgraph.app/kingdomhearts/#item=<sku_id>`.
- [Listing checker](https://merchgraph.app/kingdomhearts/check): paste a marketplace listing title (Japanese or English) to see which catalog item it most likely is, what the condition terms mean, and bootleg caution notes. Pasted text is not stored.
- Item pages: every Kingdom Hearts catalog item has its own page at `https://merchgraph.app/kingdomhearts/item/<sku_id>` (name, official status, original price, availability, sources, with Product structured data). The full list is in the [sitemap](https://merchgraph.app/sitemap.xml).

## For AI agents (MCP server)
- The same catalog is available as an MCP server that resolves fuzzy product names and listing titles to catalog entries, explains condition terms, and says whether a Japan-only shop needs a shipping-forwarding service.
- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://mcp.merchgraph.app/mcp (the older https://kh-merch-graph.fandex.workers.dev/mcp keeps working)
- Full tool list and usage notes for agents: [MCP server llms.txt](https://mcp.merchgraph.app/llms.txt)
